# SnipText

> Premium desktop region OCR: click, drag, clipboard. Clip Desk exports a local JSON ledger.

- Version: 1.2.1 The Ledger (camera shutter on capture)
- Site: https://sniptext.jonbailey.xyz/
- Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/SnipText
- Download (Windows EXE release): https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/SnipText/releases/latest
- License: MIT with attribution (see NOTICE) - credit Pitchfork-and-Torch when reusing
- Author: Pitchfork-and-Torch

## What it does

1. Global hotkey opens a multi-monitor selection overlay
2. Drag a region (Snipping Tool feel); release captures at native resolution
3. Vision AI (xAI Grok default) or local OCR transcribes text
4. Result is copied to the clipboard; optional editable preview
5. Clip Desk (tray) searches, pins, recopies, and exports a local JSON ledger

## Privacy

- Images stay in memory unless the user saves them
- API keys store in OS keyring / local config - never inside the EXE
- Local-only mode never networks
- Ledger export is a JSON file you choose. Nothing is uploaded.
